packageRules.description: Non-major updates land on their own: Renovate enables GitHub auto-merge, so a green PR joins the main merge queue without a human. The queue tests it on top of the latest main, so the branch is never rebased just to stay current (rebaseWhen: conflicted). A merge deploys to production, so a release must be 3 days old first: most broken releases are yanked or patched by then.
pnpm-workspace.yaml defaults minimumReleaseAge to 1 day (1440 min) and pnpm install fails on younger @sneat/* versions; wait 2 days so Renovate never proposes a version pnpm will reject.
